name: File drop zone
summary: A large target around a native file input that takes dropped files as well as picked ones.
description: Without JS the whole zone opens the file picker and the native input shows the chosen file name. With JS, dropped files go into the same input, so the form submits them as if they were picked. It does not upload on its own.

classes.name: v-dropzone
classes.description: The dashed <label> that wraps the file input and its text.

classes.name: v-dropzone-icon
classes.description: The round icon at the top.

classes.name: v-dropzone-title
classes.description: The main line; a <strong> inside is drawn in the accent, like a link.

states.description: Set by the JS while files hover over the zone: accent border and tint.
Honoured on drop: refused files are announced and left out.
On the input: the zone is dimmed and drops are ignored.
On the input, or :user-invalid on a required one: danger border on the zone.

hooks.name: data-v-dropzone
hooks.description: Adds drag and drop to the zone and lists the chosen file names.

hooks.name: data-v-dropzone-files
hooks.description: Where the chosen file names are written. Added at the end of the zone when missing.

events.name: v:change
events.description: Fires after files are picked or dropped, with the input's FileList.

keyboard.action: Focuses the file input; the ring is drawn round the whole zone.

a11y: The native input keeps focus and keyboard behaviour, so the zone works without a mouse.
Say which types and sizes are accepted in the visible text, not only in accept.
Refused files (wrong type, more than one when multiple is off) are announced politely.
The upload icon is aria-hidden; the title and the input name the control.

examples.title: Drop or browse
examples.description: Drag a PDF or image onto the zone, or click to pick one.

examples.title: Drag over and disabled
examples.description: data-v-dragover is set by the JS; it is written by hand here to show the look.
